== Biography ==
William, born about 1826 in Stamford Township, Welland, Upper Canada (Ontario), was the son of Rev. Samuel Glasgow, who settled in Stamford before the War of 1812. 

William married Mary Elizabeth Lundy,<ref>"Ontario Deaths, 1869-1937 and Overseas Deaths, 1939-1947," database with images, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:J6QP-D8Q : 27 April 2019), Mary Elizabeth Lundy in entry for Sinclair Holden Glasgow, 13 Mar 1909; citing Welland, Welland, Ontario, yr 1909 cn 30631, Registrar General. Archives of Ontario, Toronto; FHL microfilm 1,854,621.</ref> the daughter of James Lundy.They settled in Stamford<ref>"Canada Census, 1851," database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MWTK-5VW : 3 August 2016), William Glasgow, Stamford, Welland County, Canada West (Ontario), Canada; citing p. 63, line 26; Library and Archives Canada film number C_11757, Public Archives, Ontario.</ref> except for seven years spent in Norfolk County.<ref>Murphy, Joseph. ''The History of the County of Welland, Ontario''. Welland: Welland Tribune, 1887, p. 559 archive.org</ref><ref>"Ontario Census, 1861," database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MQ7V-4TX : 5 September 2017), William Glasgow, Townsend, Norfolk, Ontario, Canada; citing p. 27, line 40; Library and Archives Canada film number C-1053, Public Archives, Toronto; FHL microfilm 2,435,927.</ref> William was a farmer and served as a justice of the peace in Stamford.<ref>"Canada Census, 1881," database with images, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MVF6-X72 : 20 May 2019), William Glasgoe, Stamford, Welland, Ontario, Canada; from "1881 Canadian Census." Database with images. Ancestry. (www.ancestry.com : 2008); citing William Glasgoe, citing Library and Archives Canada, Ottawa, Ontario.</ref>

They had two sons, Sinclair and Oliver.<ref> "Canada Census, 1871," database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M43L-N47 : 24 October 2018), William Glasgow, Stamford, Welland, Ontario, Canada; citing 1871; citing National Archives of Canada, Ottawa, Ontario.</ref>

=== Father and source account ===
The 1887 county history expressly identifies Rev. Samuel Glasgow as the paternal grandfather of [[Glasgow-959|Sinclair Holden Glasgow]], and identifies Sinclair’s father as William, husband of Mary Elizabeth Lundy. The father relationship is assessed as 95% confident from this exact family match.<ref name="Welland 1887">''The History of the County of Welland, Ontario'' (Welland: Welland Tribune, 1887), p.559, Sinclair Holden Glasgow family account; [https://archive.org/details/historyofcountyo00murp/page/n573/mode/1up original scan, IA leaf 573].</ref> Samuel’s reported Scottish origin, Tyrone childhood and Belfast ordination await independent verification. His identity among existing profiles remains unresolved; the compatible Niagara farmer in the LAC Samuel Glasgow fonds has not yet been identified with him. No wife or earlier parent is assigned to Samuel.
